notes: Step 4 of the P3-P5 device pass (2026-10-10): whole-app behaviour by remote, everything native (FCRHN) against all JS. Each state is a key path a viewer makes; the capture at its end and the [focus] gain table must agree.
Bursts are adb loops (~130 ms a press), not a real held key.
Never OK on a Continue Watching card or on a Detail page here (that would play or download).

states.name: home-down-6
states.note: six shelves down, one press at a time: the column, the mounted shelves, focus on card 0 of row 5

states.name: home-down-4-up-2
states.note: down four, up two: back on row 1, the page where it was for row 1

states.name: home-down-hold-8
states.note: eight DOWNs in one burst (hold approximation). The rest offset can differ by the JS clamp quirk (hero.json down-burst-4); the focus table must still agree

states.name: home-row-hold
states.note: row 1: out 15, back 6 in two bursts: card 9

states.name: home-row-then-down
states.note: row 1 to card 4, then two shelves down: focus lands by the platform's own search in both; the page follows

states.name: home-open-title
states.note: OK on a poster card of row 1 opens its Detail page

states.name: home-title-back
states.note: ... and BACK returns to Home: the column still at row 1, focus on the card it was opened from

states.name: movies-grid-walk
states.note: Movies grid: two rows down, two right

states.name: movies-grid-hold
states.note: Movies grid: ten rows down, four up, in bursts

states.name: movies-open-title
states.note: OK on a grid card opens Detail

states.name: movies-title-back
states.note: ... and BACK returns to the grid, focus on the same card

states.name: movies-rail-open
states.note: LEFT at column 0 of the grid opens the rail (Movies lit)

states.name: movies-rail-home
states.note: rail -> Home from Movies: Home at rest
